                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs<\/strong>.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               Web 2.0 is sunsetting<\/strong>. In the coming agentic web, Google\u2019s ad\u2011driven model has no natural home.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up<\/strong>. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.<\/strong><\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Description of the Project <\/strong><\/h3>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          As a Quantum Applications Engineer<\/strong>, you will work at the intersection of quantum algorithms, real-world applications and customer projects<\/strong>.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Your mission will be to identify relevant problems that can be addressed using Quandela's quantum computing technology, assess their feasibility and define how meaningful performance should be measured.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Working directly with industrial and academic partners, you will translate real-world challenges into quantum computing problems, evaluate potential approaches and establish the appropriate benchmarks against classical methods.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          This is a highly technical role with strong exposure to customers and partners. It is particularly suited to someone with a background in quantum algorithms who wants to apply that expertise to practical use cases rather than focus exclusively on theoretical research.<\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          <\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Your Key Responsibilities<\/strong><\/h3>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Identify and assess quantum use cases<\/strong> by working with customers, industrial partners and internal teams to understand their challenges and translate them into relevant computational problems.<\/li>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Perform feasibility studies<\/strong> to determine whether and how these problems can be addressed using current and near-term quantum computing technologies, with a particular focus on NISQ approaches.<\/li>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Define meaningful benchmarks<\/strong>, including relevant problem instances, expected outputs, accuracy targets and classical baselines to objectively evaluate quantum approaches.<\/li>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Explore promising application domains<\/strong> and contribute to application roadmaps, from near-term demonstrations to longer-term utility-scale applications.<\/li>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Evaluate scientific, industrial and economic value<\/strong> to help prioritize the applications where quantum computing can have the greatest impact.<\/li>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Design and maintain strategic demonstrations and Proofs of Concept<\/strong>, working with internal teams or external software partners depending on the project.<\/li>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Follow customer projects throughout their lifecycle<\/strong>, including projects where algorithm development is performed by external partners.<\/li>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Present technical work to customers and partners<\/strong>, explaining quantum approaches, results, limitations and opportunities to both technical and non-specialist audiences.<\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   Wij zijn op zoek naar een teamleider van het Voordeurteam Jouw team Voordeur is het eerste aanspreekpunt van GGZ InGeest voor cli\u00ebnten \u00e9n verwijzers, en de spil in de verdere zorgketen. Het team verzorgt de eerste stap naar passende zorg voor zo'n 5000 cli\u00ebnten per jaar, nl. de inschrijving en het eerste contact voor behandeling of opname. Tegelijkertijd verandert het werk. How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.


With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.


Make an Impact as an In-House Clinical Research Associate I at Worldwide

As an In-House Clinical Research Associate I, you'll play an important role in supporting the successful delivery of clinical studies that help advance patient care. Working closely with Clinical Trial Managers, field CRAs, study sites, and cross-functional teams, you'll help ensure studies are conducted in compliance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and applicable regulatory requirements.


In this role, you'll contribute to site management activities across the study lifecycle, from site start-up through closeout. Your work will help maintain study quality, support site engagement, and ensure critical milestones and deliverables are achieved on time.


You'll be part of a collaborative global environment where attention to detail, strong communication, and a passion for clinical research can make a meaningful impact on study success.


Where You'll Work

This is a remote role open to candidates based in Serbia, Spain or Poland. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.


What You'll Do

  • Support site start-up activities, including feasibility questionnaire coordination, confidentiality agreement collection, and essential document management.
  • Maintain accurate and compliant study documentation by reviewing, tracking, and preparing site-related records for the Trial Master File (TMF).
  • Partner with field CRAs to support Investigator Site File maintenance, TMF reconciliation, and quality control activities.
  • Conduct remote monitoring activities and support pre-study, initiation, interim, and closeout visits under the guidance of the CRA or study leadership team.
  • Build strong relationships with investigative sites through regular communication and ongoing study support.
  • Review electronic data capture (EDC) systems, assist with query resolution, and help ensure timely and accurate study data entry.
  • Generate reports, maintain study trackers, and provide operational updates to Clinical Trial Managers and project teams.
  • Support site staff management activities, including training documentation, regulatory document collection, system access requests, and delegation tracking.
  • Assist sites with patient prescreening, screening, recruitment activities, and subject eligibility review tracking where applicable.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in a medical, biological, physical, health, pharmacy, or related scientific discipline preferred; or a combination of relevant education, training, and clinical research experience.
  • Clinical research experience as a Study Coordinator, Clinical Trial Assistant, or in another relevant clinical research role.
  • Basic understanding of clinical research principles, processes, and Good Clinical Practice (GCP) requirements.
  • Knowledge of FDA and/or EU regulations, ICH Guidelines, local regulatory requirements, and clinical research standard operating procedures.
  • Familiarity with electronic clinical systems such as EDC, eCRF, and IVRS platforms.
  • Strong organisational, planning, time management, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Fluent in English and a native local language, with fluency in at least one of the following additional languages required: French, German, Italian, or Spanish.

Discover the Difference


We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.  Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit , or connect with us onLinkedIn.

Real-Time Review (RTR) Specialist

Position Summary

The Real-Time Review (RTR) Specialist is responsible for reviewing residential solar installation and inspection documentation in real time to verify accuracy, completeness, workmanship, and compliance with applicable requirements.

This position serves as a critical quality checkpoint between field operations and inspection completion. The RTR Specialist works directly with field technicians and internal departments to identify deficiencies, communicate required corrections, and help prevent avoidable inspection failures, repeat visits, and project delays.

The ideal candidate combines residential solar knowledge, technical judgment, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively in a fast-paced operational environment.

Core Responsibilities

Real-Time Inspection Review

  • Review field-submitted photographs, inspection documentation, and installation details as they are received.
  • Verify that documentation meets company standards and applicable inspection requirements.
  • Identify missing photographs, incomplete documentation, installation deficiencies, and potential compliance issues.
  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to field technicians while they are on-site.
  • Verify that identified deficiencies have been appropriately addressed before closing the review.
  • Maintain timely review turnaround to minimize field delays.

Technical Quality & Compliance

  • Review residential solar PV installation components, including inverters, disconnects, electrical panels, conduit, labeling, grounding, and related equipment.
  • Identify potential discrepancies between approved plans and installed equipment.
  • Apply working knowledge of NEC requirements, AHJ standards, and company installation procedures.
  • Recognize technical issues requiring additional review by qualified electrical or operational personnel.
  • Document recurring installation or documentation deficiencies.

Field Communication & Coordination

  • Communicate directly with field technicians regarding required photographs, corrections, and documentation.
  • Coordinate with Inspection Scheduling, Permitting, ESC, Installation, and other operational departments.
  • Escalate unresolved technical issues, inspection risks, and project delays to the appropriate leadership.
  • Provide accurate status updates and maintain clear documentation of outstanding items.
  • Support timely resolution of issues that could affect inspection readiness.

Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Maintain accurate review records, correction notes, and completion statuses in company systems.
  • Follow established review procedures and documentation standards.
  • Identify recurring deficiencies and recommend improvements to field documentation and inspection readiness.
  • Support consistency and accountability across inspection review processes.

Qualifications

Required

  • Experience in residential solar installation, inspection operations, quality control, or a closely related technical field.
  • Working knowledge of residential solar PV systems and electrical installation components.
  • Familiarity with applicable NEC requirements and AHJ inspection standards.
  • Ability to interpret installation photographs, technical documentation, and approved plans.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify technical discrepancies.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple active reviews in a time-sensitive environment.
  • Sound judgment, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently.
  • Proficiency with digital documentation, project management, and operational software.

Preferred

  • Previous experience in real-time solar inspection review.
  • Experience supporting residential solar inspection technicians.
  • Familiarity with solar permitting and inspection workflows.
  • Experience identifying installation deficiencies and coordinating corrective actions.

Performance Expectations

Success in this position is measured by:

  • Accuracy and completeness of real-time reviews.
  • Timely communication of deficiencies and required corrections.
  • Consistent adherence to established review procedures.
  • Quality and clarity of review documentation.
  • Reduction of preventable inspection failures and repeat field visits.
  • Effective coordination with field technicians and operational departments.
  • Timely escalation of unresolved technical or compliance issues.
  • Ability to maintain quality while managing multiple active reviews.

Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.
  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

    Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

    (NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

    At Oceans, we believe that talent knows no boundaries. That’s why we connect the best and brightest professionals with career-defining opportunities that challenge, inspire, and accelerate their career growth. Our community, whom we call Divers, don’t just work—they dive deep, solve complex challenges, and make a real impact with global industry leaders. And in doing so, they don’t just support bold ideas—they expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers.

    As a Creative Director, you will join a fast-growing beauty and hair-care brand expanding its digital operations across the LATAM region. You will take charge of a lean, high-performing creative function built to support rapid digital expansion through short-form content, paid advertising, organic social media, and e-commerce creative. Rather than traditional, big-budget agency productions, this business prioritizes high-volume, performance-driven content production executed with efficiency and resourcefulness.

    This is a true "player-coach" role designed for a creative leader who thrives on both setting direction and rolling up their sleeves to execute hands-on. You will oversee copywriting, graphic design, and video editing as a single, integrated creative pod, establishing visual standards, guiding team members, and maintaining high output velocity. Balancing creative quality, brand consistency, and budget discipline, you will drive impactful storytelling and content repurposing that fuels sustainable growth across digital channels.

    Accountability

    As a Creative Director, your success will be defined by your ability to lead a multidisciplinary creative pod and consistently deliver high-volume, performance-oriented content that drives engagement and brand consistency.

    Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

    Creative Leadership & Pod Management

    • Lead the copywriting, graphic design, and video editing functions as one unified creative team.
    • Provide clear creative direction, actionable feedback, and workload prioritization to pod members.
    • Establish efficient production workflows to resolve creative bottlenecks and ensure on-time asset delivery.
    • Review all creative output for visual quality, narrative relevance, and strict brand alignment.

    Creative Strategy & Performance Concepting

    • Develop high-converting creative concepts for paid advertising and organic social channels.
    • Translate marketing objectives into concise, executable creative briefs for static, motion, and video assets.
    • Identify creative hit rates across campaigns and iterate on successful concepts to generate variations.
    • Leverage AI tools to accelerate ideation, storyboarding, and rapid content repurposing.

    Organic Content Production & Activation

    • Directly create and produce organic social content hands-on, maintaining a weekly content calendar.
    • Coordinate creative production tailored specifically to short-form platforms like TikTok and Instagram Reels.
    • Repurpose existing footage and user-generated content (UGC) into engaging organic assets.
    • Review organic reach and engagement metrics to continuously inform future creative direction.

    Paid Advertising & UGC Repurposing

    • Oversee the production of fresh performance advertising creative across paid channels.
    • Collaborate with copywriters on hooks and messaging, designers on visual hierarchy, and video editors on short-form execution.
    • Transform UGC and creator content into multi-platform paid advertising variations.
    • Review advertising asset performance with digital stakeholders to continuously improve hit rates.

    Lean Production & Budget Ownership

    • Plan, schedule, and direct practical, monthly photo and video shoots within defined budget parameters.
    • Maximize the volume of reusable photo and video footage generated from every lean production shoot.
    • Manage the monthly creative production budget, tracking cost per asset and optimizing resource allocation.
    • Maintain an organized, on-brand creative asset library to streamline future content development.

    Colleagues

    You will report directly to the Chief Marketing Officer while partnering closely with the VP of Digital, performance marketing leads, and affiliate stakeholders to align creative execution with broader growth targets. On a daily basis, you will manage a multidisciplinary creative pod consisting of a Senior Copywriter, Senior Graphic Designer, and Video Editor.

    At Oceans, you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

    Skills and Qualifications

    At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area, paired with broad curiosity and interests. As a Creative Director, your vertical strength will be Creative Concepting, Storytelling & Short-Form Content, while your horizontal capabilities should span Team Leadership, Performance Creative Optimization, and Lean Budget Management.

    To excel in this role, you should have:

    • Experience: Proven track record leading small, fast-paced creative teams (in-house or DTC brand experience preferred), with hands-on experience in short-form social content (TikTok, Instagram Reels) and paid social advertising. Experience in the DTC beauty or personal-care space is a strong plus.
    • Tools/Systems: Proficiency across visual design and video editing software (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, frame-accurate review tools), social platforms, and asset management systems. Comfort utilizing AI tools for ideation and storyboarding.
    • Analytics/Process: Ability to interpret creative hit rates, CPC/CPA metrics, and engagement data to refine content; strong production management skills with experience establishing high-volume content workflows and managing lean shoot budgets.
    • Mindset: A player-coach mentality with high operational agency, speed, and resourcefulness—prioritizing output efficiency and output speed over expensive, complex setups.

    During the interview process, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

    • Creative Leadership & Pod Management: How do you structure workflows, unblock bottlenecks, and mentor a multidisciplinary team of copywriters, designers, and video editors?
    • Short-Form & Performance Creative: How do you concept, produce, and adapt high-performing content across TikTok, Reels, and paid social channels?
    • Hands-on Execution & UGC Repurposing: How do you personally approach content creation and turn user-generated content into multiple high-converting creative assets?
    • Lean Production & Budget Management: How do you maximize asset yield from lean photo/video shoots while strictly managing production costs and budgets?

    Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported

    Role Specifications

    This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

    About Oceans

    At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

    We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

    Want to learn more about our recruitment process, what to expect from interviews, and possible outcomes? Check out [The Dive].

    The Field Application Scientist (FAS) is responsible for supporting the technical business functions of Fortis Life Sciences in a pre-sales and post-sales manner with an emphasis on the nanoComposix portfolio. The purpose of the role is to support customers with applications questions related to the nanoComposix portfolio and complimentary products within the Fortis portfolio in a pre-sales and post-sales manner. The FAS will communicate internally with the commercial organization on the technical applications of products with the goal of supporting continued growth of the Fortis portfolio and brand.

    General Functions

    • Become an expert in all applications supported by Fortis products including proficient knowledge in experimental set-up, troubleshooting, and accessory products/instrumentation
    • Conduct ongoing product and application presentations and trainings for customers
    • Participate in internal global field application calls to maintain knowledge and proficiency of all products and applications
    • Troubleshoot issues with on-market products as needed
    • Communicate with customers and commercial organization on a routine basis, keeping all parties informed and up to date
    • Learn new product portfolios as they become available and train internal team and customers on new offerings

    Pre-Sales Functions

    • Understand the technical details of open opportunities and be able to discuss a technical strategy with the account manager to ensure a successful win
    • Conduct product demonstrations and technical presentations remotely and in-person
    • Technically compare the benefits of Fortis products and highlight the shortcomings of competitive products
    • Assist in mapping out bulk strategy for key accounts by recommending product type and volume based on customer’s needs and workflow

    Post-Sales Functions

    • Answer e-mails and phone calls from customers in timely manner
    • Escalate issues to manager when necessary and design customer facing plans to help customer troubleshoot and resolve issue within timely manner
    • Document knowledge in solutions within Salesforce.com for field team to access and reference as needed
    • Host remote trainings and presentations for customers
    • Follow-up with customers to ensure customer adopting product into workflow successfully

    Education and Experience

    • 4-year bachelor’s degree in life sciences, chemistry, or engineering required. Masters or PhD preferred
    • 2+ years working in a technical commercial role supporting customers in pre-sales and post-sales situations
    • 2+ years practical experience working with nanoparticles in diagnostic, lateral flow, nanomedicine, or other life science applications
    • High degree of computer literacy in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint and ability to utilize computer-based tools for reports, email and for general communication

    Skills & Knowledge

    • Life sciences, biotechnology, nanoparticles, nanomedicine, diagnostics, antibody-based assays, flow cytometry, imaging, lateral flow assays, ELISA
    • Excellent oral and written English communication, including communicating in a way that a non-technical end user can understand
    • Ability to think, learn, and solve problems quickly
    • Ability to operate independently and remotely with at least 1 weekly meeting with supervisor
    • Organized, well prepared, and maintains a professional appearance and conduct
    • Ability to maintain flexible travel schedule during the work week

    Other Information

    • This position requires up to 75% travel
    • Based in U.S. (West Coast preferred)

    What We Offer

    We have an incredibly talented group of intelligent, down-to-earth individuals who are committed to developing and manufacturing only the highest quality products. Our mission: “Pursuing a Healthier World by Creating Tomorrow’s Science Today” is complemented by our core values:

    § Customer First - We prioritize the experience and outcomes of our customers above all.

    § Integrity - We are honest and accountable, holding ourselves to a high standard of ethical conduct.

    § Trust - We believe an engaged, empowered team begins with a foundation of trust. We trust our team members to make the right decisions and to be driven by and evaluated on results.

    § Entrepreneurship - We encourage smart risk taking. We value novel mistakes in the pursuit of innovation.

    § Excellence - We believe in solving for root cause. No shortcuts, no “band-aids”.

    Fortis provides a competitive salary, success-sharing bonus plan, medical, dental, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) plan. We are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We are an E-Verify Employer in the United States.

    Fortis Life Sciences is a strategic platform partner providing capital, expertise, and operational resources enabling the growth and success of founder-led life sciences tools companies. Fortis was founded in 2020 with the vision of creating a Life Sciences company for top-quality products supported by a superior customer experience. Fortis’ mission is to create a healthier world tomorrow by supporting today’s scientific advancement. You will be working in the fast-growing and rewarding field of life sciences where employees are driven by their passion to learn and make a difference in the world.

    nanoComposix is a Fortis Life Sciences company specializing in R&D and manufacturing of innovative nanomaterials for research and commercial markets supporting medical devices and pharmaceuticals. We manufacture hundreds of different variants of metal and metal-oxide core/shell nanocomposites for a wide range of applications including clinical diagnostics, medical devices, biosensors, and optical effects. Our mission is to help our clients maximize the benefits of nanotechnology through the use of precisely engineered, highly characterized nanomaterials, and to support bringing nano-enabled products to market.

    Our mission: “Pursuing a Healthier World by Creating Tomorrow’s Science Today”

      <title>Stripe: Abuse Research Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote from the US
</p>

<h2>Who we are</h2>
<h3>About Stripe</h3>
<p><span>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p>
<h3>About the team</h3>
<p>Abuse Research Group (ARG) handles proactive threat hunting and adversary behavior analysis across Stripe products. Rather than reacting to alerts, the team maps end-to-end fraud and abuse paths, validates novel attack vectors, and identifies product conditions that enable fraud. Using agentic automated testing and simulation tools, ARG translates research into actionable threat advisories, strategic control recommendations, and regression scenarios to systematically eliminate vulnerabilities.</p>
<h2>What you’ll do</h2>
<p>As an Abuse Research Engineer in the Abuse Research Group, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Stripe’s financial ecosystem by proactively hunting for advanced threats, dissecting complex fraud vectors, and extracting actionable adversary intelligence. &nbsp;Rather than relying solely on reactive alerts, you will develop and execute hypothesis-driven threat hunting operations across internal telemetry and external sources to uncover fraudulent tools, tactics, and techniques (TTPs) before they impact Stripe’s platform. Central to this work is FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0), Stripe’s multi-layered taxonomy that decomposes monolithic fraud into structured kill chains. &nbsp;Collaborating cross-functionally with Fraud Ops, Strategy, Risk, Onboarding, and Security, you will integrate threat intelligence, build agentic simulation workflows, and systematically eliminate product vulnerabilities.</p>
<h3>Responsibilities</h3>
<ul>
<li>Proactive Threat Hunting &amp; Kill Chain Analysis: Formulate hypotheses and conduct iterative threat hunting operations across Stripe systems and external data.</li>
<li>FT3 Taxonomy: Apply and enrich the FT3 framework across empirical datasets and incidents, standardizing threat intelligence across kill chain phases and targeted API endpoints. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Threat Intelligence &amp; Signal Expansion: Partner with teams like Fraud Intelligence to integrate, curate, and automate threat feeds into engineering workflows. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Cross-Functional Advisories &amp; Strategic Controls: Translate raw research and retrospective findings into actionable threat advisories and control recommendations (policy, technical systems, support workflows, and detection mechanisms) for stakeholders across Fraud, Risk, Onboarding, and Security. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Agentic Testing &amp; Adversary Simulation: Utilize agentic automated testing frameworks to simulate adversary TTPs, validate whether deployed controls interrupt empirical kill chains, and generate regression scenarios to exercise controls. &nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2>
<p><span>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p>
<h3>Minimum requirements</h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience conducting threat intelligence, threat hunting, or technical incident response within cyber security, product abuse, or trust domains.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>5+ years of experience analyzing large, complex datasets using data analytics tools to identify anomalies, map behavioral trends, and solve complex fraud problems.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated experience using code and scripting to automate workflows, build investigative tools, or query big data pipelines.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Hands-on experience in log analysis (e.g., application logs, API route telemetry, network security events), digital forensics, and cyber investigation methodologies.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Strong communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical research into clear, actionable recommendations and advisories for cross-functional partners.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Deep technical understanding of threat actor motivations, infrastructure, and TTPs specific to financial fraud (e.g., ATO, Card Testing, Credential Stuffing).&nbsp;</li>
<li>Familiarity with standardized taxonomies such as FT3 or MITRE ATT&amp;CK.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proficiency with engineering, data processing, and analysis platforms such as Databricks, Trino, PySpark, Pandas, or Scikit-Learn.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proven background utilizing Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIPs), tactical threat feeds, OSINT, and breach intelligence.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Demonstrated capability building or leveraging agentic LLM tools, automated testing systems, or control validation frameworks to model adversary behavior at scale.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Participation in industry conferences, webinars, or threat-sharing groups, alongside relevant professional certifications (e.g., GCTI, GCFA, OSCP).</li>
</ul>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.)
</p>

<h3><strong>Commercial Data Scientist</strong></h3>
<p>Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.&nbsp;</p>
<p>At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.</p>
<p><br><em>This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S.</em></p>
<p><strong>As a Commercial Data Scientist</strong>, you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare.</p>
<p><strong>How you’ll make an impact:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies.</li>
<li>Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights &amp; Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses.</li>
<li>Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects.</li>
<li>Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform.</li>
<li>Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team</strong></p>
<p><strong>As an organization we value diversity - </strong>in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Collaboration</strong>—The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.</li>
<li><strong>Passion for Data</strong>—You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.</li>
<li><strong>Reliability</strong> – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.</li>
<li><strong>Curiosity</strong> – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.</li>
<li><strong>Respect</strong> – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>About you:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>At least <strong>4 years</strong> of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets.</li>
<li>Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment</li>
<li>Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques</li>
<li>Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.</li>
<li>Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships.</li>
<li>Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training.</li>
<li>Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders.</li>
<li>Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Fun</strong> <strong>Facts About the Client Intelligence team</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections.</li>
<li>Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights.</li>
<li>The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds.</li>
<li>We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events!</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Compensation</strong></p>
<p>The anticipated total compensation for this role is $119,333 - $172,800 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.</p>
<p>Our total compensation package may include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Base salary</li>
<li>Equity (where applicable)</li>
<li>Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)</li>
</ul>
<p>Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<p>In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Medical, dental, and vision insurance</li>
<li>401(k) with company match</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off and company holidays</li>
<li>Paid parental leave</li>
<li>Professional development and learning opportunities</li>
<li>Wellness and mental health resources</li>
<li>Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Why You'll Love Working Here</strong></p>
<p>At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Make a real impact.</strong> Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.</li>
<li><strong>Work with exceptional teammates.</strong> Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.</li>
<li><strong>Enjoy flexibility and trust.</strong> We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.</li>
<li><strong>Grow your career.</strong> Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.</li>
<li><strong>Bring your authentic self.</strong> We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Our Hiring Process &amp; AI Tools</strong></p>
<p>Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity</strong></p>
<p><em>Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.</em></p>
<p><em>If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation.</em></p>

<p>

<p><strong>About the role:</strong></p>
<p>Hex’s legal function has gone from zero to a fully operating system in under a year. Now we need someone to own and scale the operating layer so it holds as the company grows. <strong>This is a builder role.</strong></p>
<p>You’ll run contract operations end to end: CLM administration, workflow optimization, template and playbook maintenance, enablement and training for the revenue team, and first-pass review and redlining of standard agreements against our playbook. Beyond contracts, you’ll build structured intake for every legal workstream across the company, own the legal governance record (privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars), manage outside counsel relationships, and own the legal tech stack. We sit at the nexus of data, AI, and collaboration, which means our legal operations have to be as thoughtful as our product.</p>
<p>We use AI tooling across legal operations, and you’ll work the same way: building agents and automations to move faster, not as a side project but as the default way things get done here. If you see a manual workflow and instinctively want to build it away, you’ll feel right at home.</p>
<p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Drive CLM adoption and enablement so the revenue team self-serves on standard deals</li>
<li>Own workflow optimization, templates, and playbooks as deal structures and products evolve</li>
<li>First-pass review and redlining of standard agreements; draft from templates as volume requires</li>
<li>Build and own structured intake for legal workstreams across the company</li>
<li>Build AI-powered workflows, agents, and automations that replace manual processes</li>
<li>Maintain the legal governance record: privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars</li>
<li>Train cross-functional teams on self-service tools and escalation paths</li>
<li>Manage outside counsel relationships and the legal tech stack</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>About You:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>3-5+ years in legal operations, paralegal, or contract management, with at least 1-2 years in-house at a tech or SaaS company</li>
<li>You’ve implemented or rebuilt a CLM (Ironclad preferred), designed intake workflows, and stood up reporting someone relied on</li>
<li>Experience reviewing and redlining commercial agreements on both sell-side and buy-side paper</li>
<li>You build with AI and automation as a natural part of how you work. You’re comfortable across AI-assisted legal tools, LLMs, and automation platforms, and willing to experiment with new ones as they emerge. This isn’t a nice-to-have at Hex.</li>
<li>Comfortable operating with autonomy in a role with a lot of white space</li>
<li>Good judgment about what you can handle and what needs a lawyer</li>
<li>You care whether people actually use what you build</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Nice to have:</em></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a company navigating exponential growth</li>
<li>Experience with corporate governance (entity management, board materials, annual filings)</li>
<li>Has used Hex</li>
<li>Strong opinions about the best way to organize a Notion workspace</li>
</ul>
<p>We know job posts like this can feel like a checklist, and nobody checks every box. If you’ve built legal ops infrastructure, you’re excited about AI, and this role sounds like the kind of work you want to do, we’d love to hear from you.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<p>In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary &amp; equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.</p>
<p>The salary range for this role is: $124,125 - $165,500.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness &amp; parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.</p>
<p>By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy:&nbsp;<span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-754370997"><a href="https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy">https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy</a></span>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Hex Technologies uses AI-assisted tools as part of our application review process, including for resume screening and fraud detection. These tools help our <strong>team </strong>evaluate applications and verify applicant information. All AI-generated recommendations are reviewed by a member of our recruiting team before any hiring decision is made. No application is automatically rejected based solely on an AI tool's output.</p></div>
